title: Coming apart after two washings. Sizes are too small
text: Coming apart after two washings. Sizes are too small. These pillow cases are soft and they are comfortable to sleep on. However, the sizing is way off. Our standard pillows fit length wise, but the cases are too narrow and we have to force the pillow fully in. Plus, after putting these through our laundry with the rest of the bedding twice, both cases are already losing stitching at the seams. They just are not constructed well. There are just too many good linen brands available to waste money on these.
